segments.en: On day 11, Alex has a small task. Alex has practised the basics, so the team gives Alex a small task. First, Alex checks "IP address" and "localhost" and writes one clear note about the work. During a short chat, Maria uses "It's sunny today." and "It looks like rain.". Alex answers politely and asks one question. Then Alex records the progress with "fork a repository" and "star a project" so the team can follow the change. The task is not big, but Alex can now explain it from start to finish.
